items.title: Trump tells Fox News Iran must 'make a deal or get annihilated'; says Xi offered to help end war
items.summary: Trump disclosed in a Fox News interview that Xi Jinping personally offered to help end the war and reopen Hormuz, while simultaneously warning Iran to 'make a deal or get annihilated.'

items.title: Araghchi declares nuclear enrichment deadlock; says enrichment question deferred to later negotiating stage
items.summary: Iranian FM Araghchi stated Iran has reached a deadlock on uranium enrichment and the nuclear program is off the table at this stage, to be deferred to a later phase of negotiations.

items.title: UANI May 13 shipping update: commercial transits near zero; 39 Iranian tankers west of Hormuz; US redirected 67 ships
items.summary: Open commercial transits have fallen to near zero since May 6; UANI satellite imagery identified 39 Iranian oil tankers near Chabahar; US CENTCOM reports redirecting 67 ships and disabling 4 since blockade began.

items.title: Kuwait arrests 4 alleged IRGC operatives after armed clash on Bubiyan Island
items.summary: Kuwait captured four alleged IRGC-linked operatives who approached Bubiyan Island on a fishing vessel; one Kuwaiti service member was injured in the exchange of gunfire.

items.title: Iran rial open-market rate holds at 1,810,000 IRR/USD on May 15
items.summary: USD/IRR open-market rate was 1,810,000 on May 15, 2026 — still roughly 190,000 rials below the 2,000,000 threshold tracked in the D1 and F8 portfolio questions.

items.title: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire extended 45 days; Lebanon-Israel direct talks enter third round
items.summary: The Israel-Lebanon ceasefire was extended by 45 days; direct talks between Lebanon and Israel over borders and Hezbollah disarmament entered a third unprecedented round.
